name: Email Hidden Formatter
description: A field formatter that hides an email until a click reveals it.
project_description:
Introduction 
 
The Email Hidden Formatter module provides a seamless solution for dynamically revealing email addresses while keeping them hidden by default. It’s particularly useful for websites that want to protect email fields from automated crawlers while ensuring a smooth user experience for legitimate visitors. Perfect for contact directories, staff listings, or user profiles.

 Features 
 
 Dynamic Email Reveal: Email addresses are hidden by default and revealed dynamically through AJAX. 
 Customizable Display Options: Manage label visibility ( hidden , above , or inline ) directly in the field settings. 
 Full Integration with Manage Display: Respects field display settings configured in Drupal’s Manage Display interface. 
 Simple Setup: No additional libraries or dependencies are required. 
 
 
This module is ideal for use cases where email addresses need selective visibility to improve security and user interaction.

 Post-Installation 
 
After enabling the module:

 
 Navigate to Manage Display for the content type containing the email field. 
 Select the Email Hidden formatter for the email field. 
 You can configure text link if you want 
 
 
The email field will now be hidden by default, with an option for users to reveal it dynamically.

 Additional Requirements 
 
This module does not require any additional modules or external libraries. It works seamlessly with Drupal core.
